shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hard offset, zero blur — reads as a card physically lifted off the table. Reserved for elements that should feel raised, not routine buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — Ticker Yellow, uppercase Primal label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Primal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 16px; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 2px; border: 2px solid transparent; background: #FFD700; color: #222222; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #D4AF37; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0033A0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Secondary CTA — solid ink background, blue on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Primal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 16px; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 2px; border: 2px solid #222222; background: #222222; color: #FFFFFF; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ink:hover, .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { background: #0033A0; border-color: #0033A0; }

components.name: Property Card
components.description: Flat card container with the optional hard-offset lift shadow for raised moments.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #E5E4E2; border: 1px solid rgba(34,34,34,0.15); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; } .ds-card--lift { box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(0, 51, 160, 0.18); } .ds-card-eyebrow { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0033A0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Primal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #222222; margin-top: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a set of board-game property/deed cards laid across a table: flat solid-color blocks, sharp near-zero corners, hairline dividers, uppercase geometric display type stamped like a card title bar. Each section behaves like its own card — bounded, self-contained, legible at a glance — rather than a continuous scrolling page of soft SaaS panels. The palette (silver, brand blue, vault gold, ticker yellow) plays the role of a fixed deck of card colors, not an infinite gradient space. Underneath the card-game surface sits the locked mood anchor: corporate badge × transit signage × financial ledger × storm shelter × vault. Cool, austere, accountable, protective — never warm, never opulent, never approachable-soft.
keyCharacteristics: Flat solid color blocks per section, like distinct card faces
Sharp corners (0px default), 2px only on buttons/badges
Uppercase geometric display type (Primal) as the card title bar voice
Fast/snappy motion — constant small ticker-like updates, not slow reveals
A fixed, small palette used consistently rather than a broad gradient system

rules.name: The Fixed Deck Rule
rules.body: No color exists outside the six-token set. A new UI need is solved by recombining these roles, never by introducing a new hue.

rules.name: The Stamped Title Rule
rules.body: Primal appears only in display/title/button contexts, always uppercase, never in body copy. IBM Plex Sans never appears in display roles.

rules.name: The Card-Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always a hard flat offset, never a soft blur. A blurred shadow reads as generic SaaS depth; an offset shadow reads as a card on a table.

dos: Do keep every new color inside the six-token Fixed Deck.
Do use hard offset shadows (zero blur) when depth is needed.
Do keep display type uppercase and geometric; keep body type sentence-case.
Do keep motion fast (120–200ms) and linear/ease-out.
donts: Don't use organic curves, pastels, script/serif type, rounded-pill containers, full-bleed photography, multi-hue gradients, glassmorphism, or bouncy easings.
Don't use a soft/blurred drop shadow.
Don't reach for Tailwind or a font CDN.
